name: Release Them
summary: In Searing Gorge, a dying archaeologist begs you to free those still laboring under Suntara's power. Their bodies have failed, and the relic guarded by Twilight's Hammer must be placed on Suntara's altar.

sections.title: A Dying Plea
sections.body: A dying archaeologist asks you to release those still at their labor, then collapses. Their bodies have given out, yet Suntara's power drives them on. The archaeologist says Suntara's altar is the key.

sections.title: The Altar of Suntara
sections.body: Northwest of the cave, in the hills above it, Twilight's Hammer Idolaters guard the Mysterious Artifact. Take the relic from them and carry it to the Slag Pit. There, set it upon Suntara's altar.

faq.q: Who asks for help with Release Them?
faq.answer: A dying archaeologist in Searing Gorge asks for help, then collapses.

faq.q: Where is the mysterious artifact located?
faq.answer: Twilight's Hammer Idolaters guard the Mysterious Artifact in the northwest quadrant of Searing Gorge, in the hills above the cave.

faq.q: Where must the artifact be delivered?
aliases: where do i take the artifact
faq.answer: Carry the artifact to the Slag Pit and set it on Suntara's altar.

faq.q: Why are the victims unable to rest?
faq.answer: The archaeologist says Suntara's power drives the victims to keep at their labor, though their bodies have given out.
